title: The Road to the Nvidia Scandal - The Wire China
gist: Intro to a Big Picture timeline: Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy Huang Le (Alice Huang) has raised national-security concerns and hit Nvidia's stock, but Nvidia was already central to U.S.-China tensions via export-control lobbying, partial Trump-era China sales, and chip smuggling.

insights.claim: Revelations of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with data-center executive Huang Le (Alice Huang), whom the U.S. government believes is a Chinese spy, have raised national-security concerns and sent Nvidia's share price tumbling.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Key-person and governance risk now priced into NVDA; headline risk tied to the national-security probe.
insights.locator: The revelations about Nvidia chief executive

insights.claim: Under President Trump the U.S. has allowed Nvidia to export some of its chips to Chinese customers while still barring sales of its most advanced AI chips.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Nvidia's China revenue is policy-contingent; the scandal could push policy back toward tighter controls.
insights.quote: allowed the company to export some of its world-beating chips to Chinese customers, while still preventing it from selling to them its most advanced chips

insights.claim: Chinese interests, aided by third parties outside China, have been accused on several occasions of smuggling Nvidia-made chips into the country.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Smuggling allegations raise enforcement risk for Nvidia's third-country partners and distributors.
insights.quote: Chinese interests, aided by third parties outside the country, have meanwhile been accused of smuggling Nvidia-made chips
insights.locator: Chinese interests, aided by third parties

insights.claim: Nvidia has campaigned over time to convince policymakers it should be allowed to keep selling chips to China, spanning both the Biden and Trump administrations' approaches.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Nvidia's lobbying posture may become a political liability amid the spy scandal.
